note: Breadth-first orbit certificate for the two-class theorem. Row i is one lattice class, represented by 'momentum'; 'parent' is the row it was reached from and 'generator' the involution g with g(momentum of parent) - momentum in Lambda = E8+E8. A 'reflection' with root r acts as x -> x - (x.r) r on the named E8 block; 'global -1' is x -> -x. Rows 0 and 1 are the two printed representatives V2^A and V2^B.
